title: The Problem I Still Think Is Mine to Solve
tldr: Between two startups, the one whose problem I love most is the one getting the least of me right now. Some honesty about why, and about the crossroads I'm actually at.

title: Teaching an AI to write like you
tldr: Our agents drafted messages that sounded like an AI. The fix was not a better prompt or a fine-tune, it was noticing that every edit staff already made was a free training signal we were throwing away. Shipped this week.

title: How I ship as a company of one
tldr: The system that lets one engineer ship for two companies: specs before code, tests before implementation, and AI agents that do the typing but not the thinking.
